title: Grier/Quotes
summary:
"Why fight for DeFoe?" (Dante Vale)
"It's my job."
- Grier ("Words of Truth, Heart of Lies")

"A soldier who doesn't follow orders creates chaos, and that cannot be tolerated."
- Grier ("The Beautiful Trap")

"Without order, there is no peace, no security."
- Grier to Dante Vale (Like Father, Unlike Son)
